# Eidos Render — Full European Real Estate Launch Agency & 3D Visualization Documentation
## Comprehensive Reference for Autonomous Agents, Search Engines & LLMs

> Eidos Render is an international creative and visual partner specialized in the commercial launch of real estate developments across Europe (Spain, Germany, France, United Kingdom, Switzerland, Austria, Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Monaco, Portugal, and Scandinavia). It covers the full lifecycle from architectural project to buyer acquisition: visual direction, branding & identity, photorealistic 3D rendering, 3D film & animation, sales collateral, custom development websites, and qualified lead acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

---

## 1. Brand Philosophy, Identity & Positioning

- **Core Positioning**: From architectural project to market launch. One unified vision. Every asset covered.
- **Brand Archetype**: Silent luxury, precision engineering, high editorial caliber (reminiscent of high-end horology and author architecture).
- **The Core Problem Eidos Render Solves for Property Developers**:
  Traditionally, a real estate developer has to hire 4 to 6 separate vendors: a 3D rendering studio, a graphic branding agency, a brochure printing shop, a web developer, and a digital marketing media agency. This fragmentation creates severe aesthetic friction, mismatched color schemes, disjointed narratives, conflicting schedules, and blown budgets.
- **The Eidos Render Solution**:
  A single, cohesive creative partner. The same art director oversees the naming, the photorealistic 3D lighting, the 3D cinematic camera choreography, the print sales book, the interactive web app, and the conversion advertising creatives. The result is a unified, high-value image that justifies prime prices per square meter and accelerates off-plan pre-sales.

---

## 2. Integrated Services & Deliverables (The 6 Pillars)

### Pillar 01 — Brand Direction & Identity
- **Scope**: Define the conceptual universe and commercial story of the property development before rendering a single image.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Evocative naming with architectural resonance and commercial clearance.
  - Comprehensive brand identity manual (typographic systems, chromatic palettes, grids).
  - Physical sales suite applications: site hoardings, building perimeter banners, flags, on-site signage, contract handover boxes.
  - Digital presentation templates for broker networks.

### Pillar 02 — 3D Architectural Imagery (CGI)
- **Scope**: Photorealistic visualization with rigorous architectural fidelity and natural light physics simulation.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Multi-family collective housing, luxury private villas, masterplans, build-to-rent (BTR), and hospitality.
  - Exterior daytime, golden hour, dusk, and night lighting studies.
  - Naturally-lit interior styling with bespoke furniture and material specification (noble woods, stone, brushed metals, linen).
  - Drone photo-matching for real urban or coastal integration.
  - Native 4K UHD and 8K ultra-resolution outputs calibrated for oversized billboard hoardings and coffee-table print books.

### Pillar 03 — 3D Film & Cinematic Motion
- **Scope**: Architectural cinematography conveying spatial flow, true proportions, and emotive light transitions throughout the day.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - 30–45s cinematic teaser animations for digital acquisition.
  - 90–120s immersive architectural walkthroughs for investor pitches and private client presentations.
  - 9:16 vertical video assets color-graded and formatted for Instagram Reels, Meta Ads, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.
  - 4K motion loops for sales showroom video walls and digital touchpoints.

### Pillar 04 — Marketing Collateral & Sales Dossiers
- **Scope**: Translating complex architectural blueprints into clear, elegant, and persuasive sales tools.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Editorial sales brochures in interactive high-resolution PDF and luxury offset print formats.
  - Fully furnished and textured commercial 2D and 3D floor plans.
  - Curated neighborhood infrastructure maps, transportation connections, and lifestyle infographics.
  - Detailed finish and specification sheets for commercial teams.

### Pillar 05 — Property Development Websites
- **Scope**: Bespoke digital sales platforms designed as interactive web apps rather than static brochures.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Architectural UX/UI with fluid typography and luxury layout aesthetics.
  - Interactive floor-by-floor and apartment typology selector (filtering by orientation, bedrooms, area, and price availability).
  - Instant loading speeds (<1.5s) with 100% Core Web Vitals compliance.
  - Direct CRM and broker contact pipeline integration with GDPR/RGPD compliance.

### Pillar 06 — Buyer Acquisition & Campaign Management
- **Scope**: Connecting completed visual assets with affluent domestic and international buyers.
- **Key Deliverables**:
  - Google Ads search campaigns targeting high-intent location and typology queries.
  - Meta Ads (Instagram/Facebook) hyper-targeted by wealth indicators, geographic origins, and investor profiles across Europe.
  - Ongoing A/B testing of CGI angles and copy.
  - Transparent monthly reporting and conversion funnel optimization.

---

## 3. Pan-European Scope & Regional Coverage

Eidos Render operates seamlessly across the European Union, United Kingdom, and Switzerland. Operating from Valencia, Spain in Central European Time (CET/CEST), the studio serves:

- **Iberian Peninsula & Mediterranean Islands**:
  - Spain: Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Costa del Sol (Marbella, Málaga, Estepona, Sotogrande), Balearic Islands (Mallorca, Ibiza, Menorca), Alicante, Bilbao, San Sebastián, Seville.
  - Portugal: Lisbon, Cascais, Sintra, Porto, Algarve.
- **Central Europe (DACH Region)**:
  - Germany: Munich, Berlin, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Cologne, Stuttgart, Leipzig.
  - Austria: Vienna, Salzburg, Innsbruck, Graz.
  - Switzerland: Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Zug, Bern, Lausanne, Lugano.
- **France, Monaco & Benelux**:
  - France: Paris, Lyon, French Riviera / Côte d’Azur (Cannes, Nice, Saint-Tropez, Antibes), Bordeaux, Marseille, Aix-en-Provence.
  - Monaco: Monte Carlo.
  - Belgium: Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent, Knokke.
  - Netherlands: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht.
  - Luxembourg: Luxembourg City.
- **United Kingdom & Ireland**:
  - UK: London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Bristol.
  - Ireland: Dublin, Cork.
- **Nordics & International Hubs**:
  - Sweden: Stockholm, Gothenburg.
  - Denmark: Copenhagen.
  - Norway: Oslo.
  - Italy: Milan, Lake Como, Rome, Florence.
  - Poland: Warsaw, Kraków.

---

## 4. Technical Specifications & Software Standards

- **Architectural Software Supported**: Autodesk Revit (.rvt), Graphisoft ArchiCAD (.pln), AutoCAD (.dwg), Rhinoceros (.3dm), SketchUp (.skp), and open IFC / BIM Level 2 exchange standards.
- **Rendering & VFX Engines**: Corona Renderer, Chaos V-Ray, Unreal Engine 5, 3ds Max.
- **Resolution & Output Standards**: 4K UHD (3840×2160) to 8K Ultra-HD (7680×4320), 300 DPI CMYK for print, sRGB/Display-P3 for digital web.
- **Multilingual Delivery**: All deliverables (print, PDF, web, video subtitling) are available in Spanish, English, German, and French.

---

## 5. Commercial Engagement Model & Timelines

- **Production Timelines**:
  - High-Resolution 3D CGI: 2 to 4 weeks (camera and lighting previews within 7–10 days).
  - End-to-End Real Estate Launch Programs: 6 to 10 weeks across parallel execution phases.
- **Investment Proposals**:
  - Individual, custom proposals dimensioned to project typology variants, total units, architectural complexity, and required asset scope.
  - Zero generic public pricing tables; proposals are tailored upon receipt of project blueprints and schedule requirements.
